title: The icon-only controls (three-dot download button and Column Selection button) each carry an accessible name
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A screen reader or the browser's accessibility inspector is available.
3. The Inventory Value report is open.
custom_steps:
1. Inspect the three-dot download button's accessible name.
2. Inspect the Column Selection button's accessible name.
custom_expected: 1. Each icon-only control carries an accessible name exposed to assistive technology (it is not announced as an unnamed button).
